meta_description:
22K likes, 753 comments - thefitnesschef_ on October 1, 2026: "What is actually in Diet Coke?🥤

Some of these ingredients sound scary. But it’s because we simply don’t know what they are. For example, caramel colouring is also sound in soy sauce. Sodium citrate is also found in jam and sports drinks. Both are harmless if consumed in moderation. Danger is in dose, not ingredient.

Aspartame is the most researched ingredient in history, and to this date there is no evidence that it inherently causes any harmful health outcomes.

People who say artificially sweetened drinks are bad for you are not consulting the body of evidence. 🙏

#dietcoke #fatloss #personaltrainer".
